errors.text: The intervention is only described as generic thermal treatment rather than spark plasma sintering at an optimal temperature of 1000 °C.
The MgAlTiVFeCo composition and ball-milled BCC starting state are not identified.
No temperature window, exposure time, oxidation environment, or corrosion electrolyte is specified.
The proposed mechanism is vague and potentially contrary to the task: formation of unspecified stable phases does not explain how detrimental intermetallic formation is overcome.
The dense microstructure, oxide barrier phases, passive-film behavior, chloride blocking, and diffusion-controlled parabolic oxidation mechanism are omitted.
No quantitative, measurable predictions for density, hardness, compression, corrosion, or oxidation are given.
No prior Mg-containing lightweight high-entropy-alloy evidence is cited.
The experiment lacks defined controls, measurements, and falsification criteria.
